description: Lists all bank (public) holidays for a region in a calendar year (default: the current year). Dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) and local to the region. England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have different bank holidays, so choose the right region. Call list_regions for the valid country and region keys. Free for 100 calls per client per UTC day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

country.description: Country key from list_regions, e.g. gb.

lang.description: Language for holiday and region names. Default en.

region.description: Region key from list_regions, e.g. scotland.

name: list_bank_holidays
title: List bank holidays
